text: On 2017-07-14, fifty of us said "national defense authorization act," and around that same day thirty-five said "the national defense authorization," thirty-four "the national defense authorization act," and twenty-nine "national defense authorization act ndaa." On 2017-07-25, thirty-six of us said "millions of americans." On 2017-07-26, twenty-six said "serving in the military." On 2017-07-28, twenty-two said "to work together," and twenty-one said "to repeal the affordable care act." We converged first and most on the defense authorization, in five overlapping forms, all peaking the same day. Where we spoke of people, we spoke of "millions of americans." Where we named the opposing project, we named it as something "to repeal the affordable care act," and offered, in the same week, "to work together." This is the record of what we repeated. We do not add to it here.
